name: Sigma Curve 1000 (preset curve library)
plain: A thousand named expressions in the manual_scheduler dialect, evaluated with the same asteval sandbox, so each one equals typing it into that node. They are grouped in 22 families: classic (hann √y default, linear, Karras ρ=7, golden, geometric, Gaussian tail), power, hann, Karras ρ sweep 1 to 20, geometric, geo_hann, smoothstep, smootherstep, tanh, arctan, circular, expo, golden q sweep, Kumaraswamy and its mirror, two-phase split knees, sine, polynomial easings, rational, double hann, Fibonacci and blends. Endpoints come from the model, from overrides, or from SDXL-like defaults (14.61, 0.0292) when nothing is wired. It warns when a curve rises or leaves the range and can clamp with a running minimum. The Gaussian-tail preset uses a tanh approximation of erf, so it ends about 0.1% above sigma_min.
math:
Symbols: m points (steps, or steps+1 with sgm); y_j = j/(m−1); x = 1−y; f Fibonacci ladder.
σ_j = expr(y, x, f, j, s, σmax, σmin); sgm drops the last point; append 0.
Typical form: σ = σmax + (σmin − σmax)·u(y), e.g. u = y^p, ½(1−cos πy^p), 1−(1−y^a)^b.
enforce_monotonic: σ ← running minimum.

props.params: curve (1000 presets), steps=20, sgm=False, sigma_max/sigma_min=-1 (read model), custom_expression, enforce_monotonic=False; sweep node: family, pick
